title: inbox_url derivation block is equivalent dead code — confuses future readers
description: inbox.rs lines 103-107: 'let inbox_url = activity["object"].as_str().and_then(|_| activity["actor"].as_str()).map(|_| format!("{}/inbox", actor_url)).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{}/inbox", actor_url));'. Both branches produce the same string. The conditional implies the activity object is checked for some reason, but it has no effect. Suggested rewrite: let inbox_url = format!("{}/inbox", actor_url); with a comment explaining that the actor document should be fetched to get the real inbox URL (tracked in issue X).
